text: Erin - flat viewing in Leith Sat at 11. 2 bed, top floor, no lift. ask how it went
Aurelio & Simone housewarming Fri 8pm, new place off Gloucester Rd. bring wine + something veggie for Simone
Kavya works @ the council now, planning dept. lives Walthamstow w/ her sister Jaya

Paolo moving to Manchester end of the month. new job @ BBC Salford, producer on the radio side. nervous re not knowing anyone up there - only contact is his cousin Santiago in Stockport. flat hunting this wknd, 3 viewings Sat, 1 Sun morning. his mum keeps sending him Rightmove links lol. ask how the viewings went
Omar's 40th - Sat 14th, back room of the Crown, from 7. Lena doing the cake. I'm sorting the playlist
Emeka - landlord selling, has to be out by early March. stressed. check in next week
Yetunde's mum moving in w/ them over the summer. converting the box room
bins Tues. dry cleaning before Thurs 5pm
dinner @ Farid & Reggie's - Sun at 1. they've got a new puppy, Biscuit. don't forget dessert
Aoife: from Galway, mum still there, brother Cian in Sydney. works in HR @ a law firm

Jada's leaving do - Thurs after work, the Lamb, from half 5. moving to Lisbon sometime next month!! remote job w/ the same company, bf Xavier going too once his notice is up early Jan. she's been learning Portuguese on Duolingo for a yr. get a card going + collect for a gift, she mentioned wanting a decent suitcase

Grace - surveyor came back w/ damp issues, buyers pulling out?? she's gutted. already packed half the flat, booked removals for the 30th, and her new place in Walthamstow won't hold forever. vendor there gave her till end of next wk. her dad offered to lend her the gap but she doesn't want to. call her tmrw evening
Ayesha = Hamza's wife. both teachers, Ayesha primary, Hamza secondary (maths). 3 kids
Dawit & Lila - engagement party cancelled, Lila's dad in hospital. text Lila sometime this week to see how he is
Farah viewing a flat in Bermondsey tmrw morning, 2nd viewing. if she gets it moves in mid Nov
Alana's bbq Sat - starts 2ish. I'm doing salads
Bethany's brother Ben got into Edinburgh, starts Sept. whole family driving him up end of Aug
Gabriel - new place has a garden finally. wants to get into growing veg. seed kit wd be a good housewarming pressie
Santiago lives Clapham, works @ Deloitte (audit). gf Layla is a nurse @ St Thomas'
remind me - Femi's dinner party next Fri at 7.30. ask re dietary, think his partner is coeliac
Seo-yeon moving back to Seoul in the new year. leaving party sometime early Dec, TBC
Dalia's cat Mochi went missing during the move. back now. she was in bits. check on her Fri
Xavier started @ Google last Mon. loves it apparently. msg him end of the week, see if still loving it
Jaya - 'Jay' to everyone - lives in Leeds w/ her husband + 2 boys. works for the NHS, admin
called Erin: offer accepted on the Leith flat!! completion early Jan, keys hopefully the 9th at noon. massive. send congrats + plant for the new place
Kavya's parents' 30th anniversary meal - Sun 26th at 6, Dishoom. she's organising, a bit frazzled
housewarming invite from Paolo for Sat the 7th, evening. decline? already at Omar's
Lena - just back from the viewing w/ her bf Emeka. loved it but over budget. they're thinking about it over the wknd
Hamza's dad retiring end of Nov after 35 yrs @ Royal Mail. surprise party, Hamza organising, keep quiet
Simone hates surprise parties. noted for the 30th next year
need to book a van for my move - sometime week of the 18th, ideally Sat morning
Reggie - Uncle Femi's funeral was last Thurs. Reggie struggling, hasn't been back to work. ring him this wknd
Aoife & her partner Grace moving in together end of Oct. Grace's place in Stoke Newington. Aoife v excited, little nervous

Dr Chen = Omar's sister-in-law, GP, the one who lives in Bristol. her husband Farid teaches engineering at UWE. two kids, both at the primary round the corner. they moved from Cardiff about 5 yrs ago. Omar says she's the only one in the family who can cook. dog called Pepper
Jada lands in Lisbon Mon at 6am. flat not ready till Weds so staying w/ a friend. msg her Tues to check she's ok
Gabriel's 30th dinner - early Feb, he mentioned the Italian on Upper St. wants a new record player, keeps sending me links
quiet one. nothing much to note. Ayesha says hi
Dawit - moving to Bristol? not decided. job offer from Arup, has to answer by Fri at 5pm. ask him Sat what he went with
Bethany's leaving drinks for her old job tonight from 6. new job @ Unilever starts Mon. good luck text Sun night
Femi lives in Peckham, flat above the bakery. vegan. supports Arsenal (unbearable about it)
Lila's dad out of hospital, home since Weds. engagement party rescheduled for sometime in spring. Dawit relieved

Santiago & Layla's wedding - 12th June next yr, Seville. save the date coming. ceremony at 6pm, party till late, welcome drinks the night before. Layla's family all coming from Bogotá so it's a big one, 200ish. they're doing a honeymoon fund instead of a list. book flights early, probably fly out the Thurs
Alana's sister Erin expecting, due end of March. Alana's going to be an auntie for the 1st time
Seo-yeon - viewing 3 flats in Seoul over video call Thurs at 9am our time. her mum's going in person. ask which one she liked
Xavier's housewarming tmrw 7ish - he said don't bring anything. bring something anyway, nice olive oil?

Paolo update - found a flatshare in Ancoats, moves in the 1st. Manchester job starts the 3rd. still anxious, says he's not sleeping. I should go up and visit sometime in Nov, maybe the wknd of the 15th

Dalia works @ the British Library, conservation - mostly old maps. her husband Aurelio is a sound engineer, freelance, does a lot of West End shows. live in Kentish Town, flat above a launderette. her brother Omar lives two streets away. no kids. she grew up in Beirut, moved here for uni
Kavya - the anniversary meal went well, parents cried. sent pics. she's knackered
must remember - Omar's party moved to Sat 21st, same time. tell Lena
Grace's sale back on, new buyers. exchange hopefully end of the month, move first wk of Dec. fingers crossed for her
Farah got the Bermondsey flat. moving 15th Nov, Sat morning. her dad Gabriel + brothers helping. I'm lending her the drill

long chat w/ Yetunde - her mum's moving down from Leeds in Aug, selling the family house. Yetunde says her mum's not coping well with leaving, lived there 40 yrs. Yetunde's also hosting a farewell lunch for the neighbours sometime late July. offered to help. ask her next wk how her mum's doing
Emeka found a place! Croydon, 1 bed, moves sometime next wk. relieved. housewarming probably Dec
Ben (Bethany's bro) - 18, into rowing, wants to row for the uni. vegetarian
Hamza's dad's retirement party - Fri 28th Nov at half 7, Royal Mail social club. Ayesha said bring photos if I have any. dig some out
Layla - shift work, nights most of Oct. hard to reach before 4pm. mum lives with them in Clapham

call w/ Aurelio: he and Dalia looking at houses in Margate, want out of London by next summer. viewing Sat at 10 and again Sun afternoon. Dalia keen, Aurelio less so (commute). her mum's in Ramsgate so makes sense for them. ask how viewings went Mon
Simone's sister Jada 'JJ' - lives in Brixton, florist, has her own shop on Atlantic Rd
grocery run + collect parcel from post office before Sat. book dentist sometime next wk
Reggie texted - back at work since Mon, doing better. dinner at his Fri at 8, Farid cooking. don't forget to grab flowers on the way
